document_metadata.title: Diagonal Spread Strategy - Comprehensive Implementation Plan
document_metadata.strategy_type: Poor Man's Covered Call (PMCC) / Diagonal Spread

executive_summary.strategy_overview: Diagonal spread combining directional bias (vertical spread) with time decay capture (calendar spread)
executive_summary.capital_efficiency: 60-90% less capital than traditional covered calls
executive_summary.primary_use_case: Generate monthly income while maintaining directional exposure
executive_summary.recommended_underlyings: Index ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM) - Superior to individual blue chips

reasons.etf_advantage: SPY: $400B+ AUM, 99.2% of S&P 500 ETF options open interest
reasons.blue_chip_disadvantage: Individual stocks have 5-10x wider spreads, lower volume
reasons.impact: Critical for diagonal spreads requiring frequent rolling
Spreads erode 2-5% per trade, compounds with rolling

reasons.etf_advantage: SPY: 500 stocks, QQQ: 100 stocks, eliminates single-stock risk
reasons.blue_chip_disadvantage: Exposed to earnings gaps, FDA approvals, CEO scandals
reasons.impact: Reduces gap risk that can blow through stop losses

reasons.etf_advantage: IV remains stable, no earnings shocks, predictable patterns
reasons.impact: More predictable theta decay, easier to model

reasons.etf_advantage: Index moves during market hours only, futures provide advance signal

recommended_allocation.primary: SPY (70% of capital) - Most liquid, tightest spreads
recommended_allocation.secondary: QQQ (20% of capital) - Tech exposure, slightly higher volatility
recommended_allocation.tertiary: IWM (10% of capital) - Small cap, highest premium but wider spreads

diagonal_vs_alternatives.optimal_use_case: Diagonal spreads excel when: 1) IV Rank < 50, 2) Directional confidence 60-80%, 3) Want to roll short leg multiple times

optimal_parameters_from_research.max_debit_rule: Pay no more than 75% of strike width

step_1_market_scan.description: Scan universe for diagonal spread candidates
process: 1. Query market data for SPY, QQQ, IWM
2. Get current price, IV Rank, IV Percentile
3. Get options chain (all strikes, all expirations)

step_2_entry_conditions.description: Evaluate if conditions are right for diagonal spread

conditions.name: Directional Confidence
conditions.calculation: From direction_predictor using RSI, BB, MA confluence
conditions.example: RSI > 60 + Price > Upper BB + Above 50 MA = Bullish 80%

conditions.name: IV Environment
conditions.rationale: Buying long-dated options cheaper in low IV

conditions.name: IV Skew
conditions.rationale: Selling expensive near-term, buying cheaper long-term

conditions.name: Liquidity Check
conditions.rationale: Tight spreads reduce slippage on entry and rolls

step_3_strike_selection.description: Select optimal strikes for both legs

validation_rules.reason: Short premium should cover or exceed long extrinsic decay

delta.action: Roll short leg to re-center delta

theta.monitoring: Track daily P&L from theta decay

vega.exposure: Net long vega (benefits from IV increase)
vega.risk: IV crush can hurt long leg
vega.mitigation: Avoid earnings dates, use indices not stocks

gamma.risk: High gamma near expiration on short leg
gamma.management: Roll short leg at 7 DTE to avoid pin risk

step_5_rolling_strategy.description: Most critical aspect - rolling the short leg to collect premium repeatedly

standard_roll.trigger: 7 DTE on short leg OR 50% profit on short leg
standard_roll.action: Buy back short leg, sell new short leg at same strike 7-14 DTE out
standard_roll.profit_taking: If short leg decayed 50%+, roll for credit
standard_roll.goal: Collect premium 3-6 times against same long leg

adjustment_roll.action: Roll short leg to different strike closer to current price
adjustment_roll.example: Bullish PMCC, stock drops: Roll short call down to lower strike

defensive_roll.trigger: Short leg goes ITM (delta > 0.50 for call, < -0.50 for put)
defensive_roll.action: Roll short leg out in time AND up/down in strike
defensive_roll.cost: May need to pay debit to roll
defensive_roll.decision_tree: If cost > 25% of original debit, consider closing entire position

step_6_exit_strategy.description: When and how to exit the entire diagonal spread

profit_exits.target_2: Stock moves strongly in favorable direction, spread worth 90%+ of max
profit_exits.target_3: Successfully rolled short leg 4+ times, long leg has < 10 DTE

loss_exits.time_stop: Long leg < 21 DTE and position unprofitable
loss_exits.direction_reversal: Technical indicators flip to opposite direction with 80%+ confidence

adjustment_exits.roll_to_new_diagonal: Close current, open new diagonal at better strikes
adjustment_exits.convert_to_vertical: If strong conviction, close short, hold long
adjustment_exits.convert_to_calendar: If direction unclear, adjust strikes to same level

order_execution: Multi-leg order support (enter both legs simultaneously)
Support for diagonal spread order type OR
Ability to leg in/out manually (less preferred)
required_order_types: BTO (Buy To Open) - Opening long leg
STO (Sell To Open) - Opening short leg
BTC (Buy To Close) - Closing short leg for roll
STC (Sell To Close) - Closing long leg

position_sizing.rule_1: Never allocate > 5% of portfolio to single diagonal
position_sizing.rule_2: Max 3 concurrent diagonals on same underlying

monitoring: Track portfolio-level delta (should be near 0 for market-neutral)
Track portfolio theta (should be positive - earning time decay)
Track portfolio vega (watch for IV crush risk)
Set alerts when portfolio Greeks breach thresholds

thresholds.delta: Portfolio delta should stay between -0.5 and +0.5
thresholds.theta: Target $100-300 daily theta decay for typical portfolio
thresholds.vega: Limit vega exposure to ±0.50 per $10k portfolio

drawdown_protection.daily_loss_limit: Close all positions if portfolio down 3% in single day
drawdown_protection.weekly_loss_limit: Stop new entries if portfolio down 7% in week
drawdown_protection.max_drawdown: Close all positions if portfolio down 15% from peak
drawdown_protection.correlation_check: Don't open multiple diagonals on highly correlated underlyings
